FFL.js source and binary references

Project: https://github.com/ariankordi/FFL.js
Version used for the browser bundle and Emscripten loader: v2.2.2
License: AGPL-3.0-only (see AGPL-3.0.txt)

The browser bundle and loader in this folder are unmodified upstream distribution files.
The corresponding upstream JavaScript sources, build configuration, and documentation are
available at:
https://github.com/ariankordi/FFL.js/tree/v2.2.2

The FFL WebAssembly binary is loaded at runtime from:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ariankordi/FFL.js/v2.2.2/ffl-emscripten.wasm

This project does not include Nintendo's FFL resource archive. Users must provide a
compatible resource file themselves.
